d:
DIVINE returns with Kaam 25, layering some of his finest lyrical work over a hypnotic beat produced by Phenom. Kaam 25 is set in the backdrop of Mumbai, a polarizing city and the canvas for the story of Sacred Games to unfold.
Sacred Games, a Netflix Original series premieres July 6.
Track Credits:
Artist – DIVINE
Lyrics – DIVINE
Co-Composers – Phenom, DIVINE
Music Producer – Phenom
Mixing and Mastering – Andrew Wuepper
